title: Finite etale pushforward preserves finite locally constant module sheaves
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite etale morphism [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and let $F$ be a finite locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values]. Then the direct image $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is a finite locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\Et}$. This is the module clause of Stacks Project Lemma 59.73.1, Tag 03RU (lemma-pushforward-locally-constant).
